objects.title: Install and Maintain Network Security Controls
objects.description: Establish and manage firewalls, routers, and network segmentation to block unauthorised access into the CDE.

objects.title: Apply Secure Configurations to All System Components
objects.description: Eliminate vendor-supplied defaults. Remove unnecessary software, functions, accounts. Disable unneeded services.

objects.title: Protect Stored Account Data
objects.description: Encrypt, truncate, mask, or tokenise PAN. Strong key management. Data retention policies must minimise storage.

objects.title: Protect Cardholder Data with Strong Cryptography During Transmission
objects.description: Use strong cryptography (TLS 1.2+) when transmitting payment data across public networks.

objects.title: Protect All Systems and Networks from Malicious Software
objects.description: Deploy and regularly update anti-malware solutions. Periodic scans and real-time monitoring.

objects.title: Develop and Maintain Secure Systems and Software
objects.description: Secure coding practices, vulnerability management, timely patching, WAFs, and change control.

objects.title: Restrict Access by Business Need to Know
objects.description: Least-privilege and need-to-know access control. All access documented and audited. RBAC required.

objects.title: Identify Users and Authenticate Access
objects.description: Unique user IDs. MFA for remote and CDE access. Strong password policies (min 12 chars). Inactive accounts disabled within 90 days.

objects.title: Restrict Physical Access to Cardholder Data
objects.description: Building entry controls, secure server rooms, surveillance, visitor management, media destruction, POI device security.

objects.title: Log and Monitor All Access to System Components and Cardholder Data
objects.description: Track and analyse all network and system activity. Logs retained 12 months (3 months immediately available).

objects.title: Test Security of Systems and Networks Regularly
objects.description: Quarterly ASV scans, internal scans, annual penetration testing, IDS/IPS, file integrity monitoring.

objects.title: Support Information Security with Organisational Policies and Programs
objects.description: Comprehensive security policy. Annual risk assessment. Security awareness training. Incident response plan. TPM management.
